presets.title: The Downtown Grid Blackout
presets.description: Substation Beta trips -> Traffic signals dark -> Downtown gridlock -> Metropolis General isolated.

presets.title: Central Gateway Bridge Severance
presets.description: Arterial bridge closed -> Traffic spills over to North Bridge -> City-wide gridlock -> Ambulances blocked.

presets.title: Metropolis General Substation Trip
presets.description: Primary electrical feed lost -> Hospital capacity drops to 45% -> Emergency intake overflows to suburban clinics.
